ASIC 200.course_name: Global Issues in the Arts and Sciences
ASIC 200.description: Selected global issues explored through the methodologies and perspectives of both the physical and life sciences and the humanities and social sciences. [3-0-0] Prerequisite: Second year standing in the Faculty of Arts or Faculty of Science.

ASIC 220.description: Sustainability examined from scientific, economic, and societal perspectives. [3-0-0] Prerequisite: Second-year standing.
